source_verification.clarity_act_formal_name: Digital Asset Market Clarity Act of 2025 (H.R.3633, 119th Congress)

senate_committee_vote.note: All Republicans voted yes; 2 Democrats crossed party lines

key_elements: Separate DeFi title addressing registration pathways for trading protocols
Disclosures, recordkeeping, supervision, BSA/sanctions compliance for DeFi
Intermediaries routing through DeFi protocols subject to examination
Sen. Mark Warner amendment: formal definition of 'truly decentralized' protocol
Warner amendment won wide bipartisan support during markup
Warren amendment (Treasury authority to sanction DeFi) was defeated
defi_provisions.exemption_precision: MODERATE — specific decentralization thresholds not publicly disclosed in bill text summary; rulemaking left to regulators
defi_provisions.hyperliquid_hip3_relevance: NOT_EXPLICIT — HL HIP-3 perpetuals DEX not mentioned; qualification depends on final decentralization definition
defi_provisions.caveat: Committee text; final floor/House version may alter DeFi title

remaining_steps: Merge with Agriculture Committee companion bill
Senate floor vote (needs 60 votes / filibuster threshold)
House version passage (H.R.3633 or Senate-reconciled version)
